Hi Angela,

Attached is Invoice 4705 for services through August. Can you confirm the expected remit date so we can reconcile for month-end? To avoid any hold on service the ideal timing would be before the payroll cut-off week (we're trying to avoid a mid-month suspension).

Payment options: ACH (preferred), wire, or virtual card. If ACH, please send the remit reference (invoice number) so the payment auto-applies. If wire, a copy of the wire confirmation/trace once sent helps our cash team.

One compliance request — we need your vendor tax form on file: a completed W-9 (if US entity) or VAT/residency stub (if EU). I attached a one-page W-9 request form to make this quick. If you already have one on file with us, please confirm the file name/date.

If there are constraints on the payment date (limits on single-day wires, approvals, etc.), let me know and we can propose a split (partial now / remainder later) to keep things moving.

Attachments: [Invoice_4705.pdf (PDF, 186 KB)], [W9_request.pdf (PDF, 42 KB)]

Thanks,

- Preferred payment method: ACH for the first chunk; wire for the second chunk if ACH limit prevents the full amount.

Also, please send your bank wiring instructions and the remit reference string we should put on the payment so it applies cleanly.

One operational note — our collections policy requires a short acknowledgement from you if the first tranche is delayed beyond the committed date; if we don't receive payment or a status update by EOD 2026-09-22 we'll move the account to a managed follow-up queue and may pause non-critical feature updates until the arrangement is honored.
